english_lines: Every wave dances; the Tamil people's,
Every art sings its own culture.
Running and playing in the forests,
notes: The source spacing `அலை யெல்லாம் / கலை யெல்லாம்` and the line break after `தமிழர்` are reflected rather than recomposed into smoother prose.
`பீடு மிகு மானினம்` remains `deer-kind, rich in dignity`, keeping the collective image.
The source's unusually segmented short-line architecture is retained line by line.
`பாவ மிடு` is kept as the performance term `set bhava` rather than silently joining or correcting the printed form.
The final eight lines are intentionally not recombined into a syntactically polished stanza; the verified source itself is highly segmented.
`முத்துத் தமிழ்` remains `Pearl-Tamil`, and the Chola-land praise remains explicit.

translator_notes: Structural fidelity is especially important here: the printed lyric works through clipped, cumulative performance-images, so the English preserves the short-line segmentation even where the result is syntactically rough.
This is a literary source-faithful translation, not a singable adaptation.
